newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1148 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1148 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 1,148 contracts compared with 819 overnight Thursday, according to the CBOT.
There were 55 wheat, 670 corn, 333 soybean, 18 soymeal, 12 soyoil, 29 corn calls, 20 corn puts, three soybean calls and eight soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1/4 to two cents higher, corn was 1/4 to 2-1/4 cents lower and soybeans were 1/4 to one cent per bushel higher.
